description: This Java class defines a metrics component for HTTP adapters in the Eclipse Hono project, extending Micrometer-based metrics and integrating with Vert.x. It is annotated as a Spring component and provides a constructor with dependency injection for a MeterRegistry and a Vertx instance.

classes.name: MicrometerBasedHttpAdapterMetrics
classes.description: A Spring component class providing metrics for HTTP adapters by extending MicrometerBasedMetrics and implementing HttpAdapterMetrics.

methods.name: MicrometerBasedHttpAdapterMetrics
methods.description: Constructor that initializes metrics with injected MeterRegistry and Vertx instances, calling the superclass constructor.
